description: CDW CIS L1 baseline device registration policy. Restricts Entra device join to specific groups, limits devices per user, prevents Global Admin auto-add as local admin, controls local admin assignment during Entra join. Covers CIS 5.1.4.1, 5.1.4.2, 5.1.4.3, 5.1.4.4. NOTE: azureADJoin and azureADRegistration use 'all' by default and require allowedGroups/allowedUsers to be populated with customer-specific group IDs to scope to a subset. Adjust to suit customer requirements.
